subject: Rebooking request — Port consolidation & HS code clarification for sponsor kits
messages:
From: Liam Ortega <liam@blueharborlogistics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana@harbor-customs-brokers.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Issue: HS code mismatch + port consolidation hold for Redwood sponsor kits

Hi Neha,

Quick heads up from the forwarder: during import processing at the Oakland gateway we hit a mismatch on the HS codes for the sponsor kit line items vs what's on the original bill of lading. The customs review has placed the consolidation shipment on hold pending corrected paperwork.

We pulled the original BOL (attached) and compared it to the manifest you sent. Two SKUs are declared with generic apparel codes; Customs is requesting the correct harmonized tariff codes for electronics (portable chargers) and printed literature. Without corrected HS codes they may assess duties and delay release by 48–72 hrs.

Options we have today:
- Submit corrected BOL/manifest with HS code updates (fastest if we can get the SKU-level codes)
- Pay provisional duties to release (we can invoice you; BlueHarbor can front, but we need authorization)
- Rebook consolidation to a later vessel/flight and move the cargo to bonded storage (adds cost but avoids immediate duty exposure)

I also flagged that the port voucher shows a different consignee name on one container — likely a clerical consolidation error. That has to be corrected to match Redwood’s PO/consignee.

I attached the BOL and our initial rebooking quote for moving the shipment to the next available vessel (sheet: rebooking-quote.xlsx). Can you confirm which route you prefer and provide the HS codes for: RDW-PO-325 (portable charger) and RDW-PO-326 (printed programs)?

Apologies for the scramble — we can escalate with Customs Broker Ana if you want us to proceed with a provisional pay to avoid the show delay.

Thanks,
Liam Ortega
Senior Account Exec — BlueHarbor Logistics
attachment: original-bol.pdf
attachment: rebooking-quote.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Ortega <liam@blueharborlogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ana Ruiz <ana@harbor-customs-brokers.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Issue: HS code mismatch + port consolidation hold for Redwood sponsor kits

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick flag.

We want these kits on-site for the event opening; please proceed with correcting paperwork rather than rebooking if that’s possible within 24 hrs. Monica / Marissa — looping you both to confirm PO coverage for provisional duties if Customs insists and for authorization of any rebooking charges.

RDW SKU HS codes (per procurement catalog):
- RDW-PO-325 (portable charger): 85044090
- RDW-PO-326 (printed programs / brochures): 49119000

Consignee discrepancy: the container shows "Redwood Events LLC" — correct consignee is "Redwood Inference, Inc." Please update the consignee on the BOL and reissue.

Liam — please work with Ana to refile corrected manifest and provide estimated incremental cost if Customs still requires duty payment. If cost is under $1,200, you have approval to pay and invoice Redwood; above that, mark as "requires approval" and hold.

I attached the sponsor kit manifest we originally gave Procurement for reference.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
attachment: sponsor-kit-manifest.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Ortega <liam@blueharborlogistics.com>, Ana Ruiz <ana@harbor-customs-brokers.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Issue: HS code mismatch + port consolidation hold for Redwood sponsor kits

Thanks Neha — confirming budget owner here. Accounting confirms we have a contingency for event freight duty exposure up to $1,200. If BlueHarbor pays provisional duties <= $1,200, invoice Redwood and we will process within standard net-30. Please proceed.

If costs exceed $1,200, please submit a quick PO change request (we'll fast-track approval) — include vendor quote and expected turnaround.

Marissa, please monitor the manifest reissue and confirm the crate-level packing list matches the revised HS lines before the crate moves to bonded release. If customs requests additional samples or photos, collect and send immediately.

Monica Patel
Director, Events Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Ana Ruiz <ana@harbor-customs-brokers.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Liam Ortega <liam@blueharborlogistics.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Issue: HS code mismatch + port consolidation hold for Redwood sponsor kits

Hi all,

We submitted the corrected manifest with the HS codes (85044090 and 49119000) and updated consignee to "Redwood Inference, Inc." — awaiting acceptance from Oakland Customs. I recommend BlueHarbor proceed with provisional duty payment to avoid the 48–72 hr clearance delay; we expect acceptance within 12–18 hrs.

Estimated provisional duty: $975 (calculated on declared value X rate). BlueHarbor, please confirm if you will pay and invoice. Once accepted I'll request release and coordinate transfer to the bonded warehouse for staging at Moscone Center (dock appointment requested for 11/04).

If Customs rejects the manifest refile for any reason, we'll need the commercial invoice with line-item values and supplier declaration for the chargers — Neha, can you confirm the supplier is "SunPeak Electronics" and provide the commercial invoice?

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Harbor Customs Brokers
phone: +1 510-555-0192

From: Liam Ortega <liam@blueharborlogistics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ana Ruiz <ana@harbor-customs-brokers.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Issue: HS code mismatch + port consolidation hold for Redwood sponsor kits — Release confirmed

Quick update — Customs accepted the corrected manifest this morning and authorized release after provisional duties were paid. BlueHarbor covered the provisional duty of $975 as discussed and has submitted the invoice to Redwood (invoice #BH-44321).

We rebooked the consolidated container to land at Oakland and be trucked to Moscone bonded staging for 11/04 dock appointment; however, due to a last-minute chassis shortage the trailer staging window slipped to 11/05. Current ETA for arrival at Moscone bonded yard: 11/05 15:30 PST.

Marissa — please confirm that the on-site receiving team will accept the pallet configuration and that the forklift team is aware of the oversized pallet (two skid stack, 48" x 40" x 72") — photos attached in the pallet notes on the Drive link.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Approve BlueHarbor invoice BH-44321 (we were authorized to pay provisional duty)
- Confirm on-site forklift and storage acceptance for 11/05 afternoon window
- If anything changes, advise immediately — we have a contingency to divert to bonded long-term storage but that will add ~ $420 extra handling.

Thanks everyone — sorry for the disruption and glad we have the kits en route.

Best,
Liam Ortega
BlueHarbor Logistics
